title: dactylorhiza × rombucina
intro: Dactylorhiza × rombucina, commonly known as the Rombucca Spotted Orchid, is a hybrid orchid species resulting from the cross between Dactylorhiza sambucina and Dactylorhiza maculata. The Rombucca Spotted Orchid has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may aid in reducing inflammation and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral properties, making it a potential treatment for various infections and diseases. The bioactive constituents of Dactylorhiza × rombucina include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
